description: Renames a Contacts tag or archives it (archived: true), as the Contacts page's tag menu does. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: edit_contact_tag
title: Rename or archive a contact tag
